title: A passing drama is too short for waste
summary: This meets the restless mood that treats the body like permanent shelter and the day like endless inventory. The line brings mortality close enough to clean up urgency.
takeaway: Remember the passing body before you spend the day.
lifeApplication: Before gossip, doomscrolling, or one more petty chase, feel the body's fragility in the breath and ribs. Let temporary life rebuke the waste.

source.shortMeaning: This brief body should not be spent as though the drama were permanent.
source.lifeApplication: When you waste the hour, remember how temporary the body already is.
